title: Thea NDE3630 NDE 3630
content: The first time: I was a little over four years old at the time. I remember being in an ambulance which was taking me to a hospital in another city when, all of a sudden, I found myself way, way up high watching the ambulance on the road. I could see the landscape in minute detail and the colors were quite intense. I could see very far all the way around, but at the same time I was focusing on the winding road, I remember this very well. Many years after, I was on a bus, which followed the same route. I decided to walk, I had this strange feeling that I should not have been in that place at all. The second time: I was with my uncle, aunt and two cousins when I decided to go swimming in the river. I wanted to show off that I was a good swimmer but the river undercurrent took me away to this drop off near the foot of a bridge. They told me later that a professional swimmer who happened to be there on vacation at his grandparents' got me out of the water but that I did not look scared at all. What I did not tell them was that I had panicked and struggled for a several minutes before I decided to completely give up. When I did give up, the water disappeared and all around me there was this gentle light that did not hurt my eyes, and I experienced a sense of total peace and calm. I remember thinking that if that was death it was fine with me. I would like to tell you that I had an unhappy childhood, with an alcoholic father and a mother who did not have much time for me, so being there in that place was a wonderful thing for me, indescribable.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Two episodes described: (1) as a little over four years old, in an ambulance en route to a hospital; (2) nearly drowning while swimming in a river with an undercurrent near a bridge drop-off.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Two separate NDE-like events: an out-of-body observation high above an ambulance route; and a drowning episode followed by water disappearing, gentle light, and total peace/calm.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Event 1 emphasizes OBE vantage over an ambulance/landscape without tunnel/light. Event 2 emphasizes panic then surrender, followed by disappearance of water and gentle light/peace, without tunnel, beings, boundary, or return description.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Two distinct events (1976 and 1979) are described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: In the first event, the experiencer reports being very high above the ambulance and seeing the landscape and winding road in minute detail with intense colors; later recognition of the same route while on a bus and a feeling they 'should not have been in that place at all.' In the second event, upon giving up during drowning, 'the water disappeared' and was replaced by a gentle, non-hurting light and total peace.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I found myself way, way up high watching the ambulance on the road.” “I could see the landscape in minute detail and the colors were quite intense.” “When I did give up, the water disappeared and all around me there was this gentle light that did not hurt my eyes, and I experienced a sense of total peace and calm.” “I remember thinking that if that was death it was fine with me.” “...being there in that place was a wonderful thing for me, indescribable.”
